text: This app works great! I've never had an issue with it working like it should. There are several things I wish were improved. I would like to be able to change the font color, it's hard to see when you have a lighter background, I'd like to change the font to black or a darker color for lighter backgrounds. I would LOVE if there was a download for the computer to link the app, so that I could quickly enter my information and it was on the app, this would be a game changer.

IT'S THE BEST. It's so simple to set up. I've been looking for something that I can use personally similar to what my master in taekwondo does. He sets the timer for certain minutes as work out, then cool down then rest a few minutes then start all over again. This is exactly the same. I don't think there is something any better than this in its functionality and simplicity. I am just so happy I found this when I ask AI to recommend the most simple functional timer for workout.

This is great!!! I was looking for an easy simple app that gives timer with intervals and beeps in between for a variety of exercises. I can set a countdown, rests and intervals, for many different exercises. I can save them with the name of the exercise and all I need is to pick the one I'm doing. I just wished the app desnt ask a notification option each time. (I opted it out and the app wants to be turned on.)

Great timer, only wish it had a setting to adjust time before the workout starts after you press start so you can get gloves on etc. In the meantime, I put an extra set to account for this. Otherwise, no-nonsense ui makes for a great workout Actually it does have that feature! When you edit the preset, there's an option called prepare.

Only complaint is you are unable (or I have yet to discover how) to set different time intervals within the same workout--you have to set work time and rest time, wait for it to be completed, then select the next saved interval. I like to do circuits with varying work/rest times, so it probably isn't an issue for someone looking to do more traditional interval training. Still recommend it, just can be a pain for specific scenarios.

This app is exactly what I was looking for. I use it to time my stretches in the mornings and evenings, and it beeps as it automatically goes to the next timing segment so I know when to switch. Because of this, I don't have to count in my head and can be reading or doing other things while stretching, which is really helpful. You can also easily adjust how many sets you want to do (it's meant specifically for interval workouts I think), how long you are working and how long you rest in between.

Easy to set intervals following your own odd needs. To me the best part is you can "name" your interval blocks so instead of a five second "rest" I can have a five second "right leg forward" and then the next block name is the yoga position for however long I want to stretch into it. I went ahead and made the purchase to rem the ads because it's worth the couple of bucks.

Simple and effective, it just does what it says. You can set the length of a warmup session, customize the number of the work/rest intervals, customize the length of each, and it'll give you a three beep countdown to let you know when it's time to switch, then it'll give you a (custom set) cool down timer. Combine it with a heart rate monitor for best effectiveness, and you're on the road to fitness whether by bike, running, spinning, or treadmill. Five stars!

Just what I needed. I decompress my neck once a week...3 minutes @ close to 40 lbs pressure and then @ 15 lbs for 1 minute each cycle. I do that for 20 minutes. I use to do it looking at my wrist watch. What a pain. Then I found this app and can set the whole 20 minute process up to run automatically letting me know by sounds when I need to increase or decrease the pressure. Now I don't incur the hassle of having to squint at my watch for the entire 20 mins. PERFECT!

I do interval training and needed something to track me, without the need of starting and stopping a timer. I currently have 6 interval timers saved, and this has made all the difference for me! My workouts are more streamlined and I don't need to worry about my heart rate dropping too low between sets. You can set prep time, length of each set, and rest time in between, and you can save each timer by its own name or purpose (ie: Warmups, Warmup Sprints, etc). This app is perfect!

It's a very useful app and mostly intuitive. I like the color coding and audible signals. For the dev team, it would be great if on the "Work" interval section, one could add a different interval in between. For example, I do a kettlebells circuit training of 18 30-seconds intervals, there is one interval that needs to last 60 seconds in the middle of the workout, but the app does not provide the option. As a workaround, I do the 60 second exercise at the end during the "Cooldown"

This app is almost perfect! I use it for my firearm training drills and it's very useful. My only complaint is that you can only set timers for whole integers of seconds. I would like the ability to add decimals for 2.5, 2.25 second timers etc. Other than that my only request is a greater variety of options to choose from in the sounds library. Good app, could be improved

I really like this app. I've used it for more than 5 years at this point, across several phones. It's basic and easy to use--it just works. If you don't care about saving your various interval timers (I don't) you don't need an account. Another bonus, it functions on top of other audio on your phone, so you can listen to a podcast or watch a video and use this simultaneously. The beeps just play over the top of the other audio.

I love this app! I couldn't stand the music of the workout videos I was doing, so I put the workouts on this app. I check out albums on the hoopla app, and play them while I work out, so there are no ads! This app runs flawlessly, and works with music playing on other apps. It is so easy to use - I am NOT tech savvy and figured it out quickly. In addition too the exercise text on each time interval, I have found it helpful to write "next is ____" to give myself a preview of whats next.

Best for creating custom workouts! Easy to use and work seamlessly! No bloat ≡ƒæÅ≡ƒÅ╛≡ƒÄë Wish there was a way to skip interval, forwards and backwards. Also, an option to share with an another user would be great. For example, I created a great workout, and it would be nice to share it with my husband's account.

Does exactly what I want it to. Let's me program consistent intervals. I mostly use it for emom workouts, but it's also useful for harder to count intervals like working for 47 seconds and resting for 27 seconds or whatever you want to come up with. I can also save specific timers for specific workouts, which makes it easier to get to work when I'm still groggy in the morning.

I love this app, it's very simple and easy to use, the only thing that I don't like is I wish there was a different sound for when the last interval is finally over so you do not have to be counting to know when you are done. I actually use this for exercising horses as much as I do for myself, and it is very useful but I constantly have to look at my phone (I have no sense of time) to know how long we've been going and how many intervals are left.

Love it so far! It's super simple and easy to use. It lets you put in the number of reps as well of the amount of time you want to do them for and the amount of rest. Three second before each workout or rest starts and ends it counts down so you can be prepared. Love it so far work good for cardio, stretches, strength training.

I am just starting a new workout program on the Aeroski and it involves interval training. I wasn't sure where to start. After doing a little research, I decided to try this app. It worked PERFECTLY!!! It was easy to figure out how to set it up, I was able to make each exercise a different color and it called out the specific exercises to me when it was time to do that exercise. Magnificent!!!

It does exactly what you'd want and expect it to do. Set total time, set intervals, "prepare"time, etc. And audible cues at the end of each. No 5 stars because the whole thing is very basic and there's no extra customizations for voice cues, or other similar things. Great simple app, for whatever your timer needs are. EDIT: Found a bunch more ways to customize a lot of things. So it nudged it to five stars

Great timer app! Very easy to set my intervals for weight lifting, battle ropes, kettlebells, jump rope, or any other activity! Definitely worth the money to remove the ads too! Looking forward to future updates! 11/2025: Still love it. Worth every penny. I had to switch phones, and thankfully, logging in to my Internal Timer account brought over all of my saved workouts effortlessly.

Best interval app I've ever come across! I used it when I was interval running (Jeff Galloway method) and I'm now using it for Cross Fit style workouts from Constantly Varied Gear! It's perfect that you can adjust the volume in the app separately from your media volume. Adjust time easily and sets! It never interrupts my music/podcast levels! It's perfect and I'll never need another!

Straightforward app! Allows you to get to work right away with no frills! Unlike many training or lifestyle apps that require a lot of setup and data entry this app lives up to its name. It is an interval timer that allows you to structure your work/rest intervals. The ads weren't bad and to go ad free is really a good deal. Highly recommend.

If you need a timer, I love this one! Simple, but did what I needed it to do. I workout all the time - like 5-7 days a week. I have not played with Interval Timer much but in the 30 seconds after I downloaded it at the gym, I was able to set up a timer as a test that let me try 4 different exercises (reps) with 15 seconds rest & 45 seconds work. I have tried other timers and hate them or can't get them to work - even at home when I have time on my hands.

Edited: Came back to add a star and fix my initial impression. Found out that the reason I couldn't hear the alarm was that several settings had to be adjusted for volume -- phone's sound, phone's media settings, AND the app's volume settings. Once all 3 were set, could hear the timer alarm from my waistpack. Simple, pretty, easy to read. Got this app to use with phone in waist pack while doing timed run/walk intervals. Would love to be able to add timer for a 5 min warmup and 5 min cooldown

text: Very nice app.! It's great for stretching exercises. I've been having to mentally COUNT seconds on all my reps. The only thing I would change would be to make the background interval wording of a darker contrasting color, where you could see it from further away, but the app works great!!! I give it a THUMBS UP...!

This is by far the best workout timer app out there. I've tried a couple and eventually purchased this one. One suggestion, I would like to see an "Up Next" section at the bottom of the current activity so I can prepare myself for the next exercise if I forget what it is. So like if I'm on a 30 sec rest activity, at the bottom, it could say "Up next, (title of next activity)". Other than that, awesome app!

Very easy to set up fully customized interval timers, with multiple saved presets. You can have several different time intervals with different work/rest times as part of each preset, including titles that the robot will read to you as they click through. Also includes a easy quick setting at the top, if you know you'll be doing the same thing every time, or if you know you'll soing something slightly different every time. Ads are not at all intrusive. Really couldn't ask for more. Great app.

So simple. Exactly what I needed with none of the extra fluff. Plays in the background, so if you swipe out, no worries. I wear this during interval training attached to a band around my waist. With the volume all the way up, I don't need headphones to hear the cues (3 beeps) to slow down/speed up. Wonderful.

I've been using this app for years and it's a part of every workout. I use it as my warm-up timer, round timer when hiring the heavy bag, or to guide my circuit training. you can customize just about every aspect you need and can store several workout timer routines. It's a straight-forward and reliable timer app.
works exactly as you'd want it to
